##: One complete toolchain: `cx`, the compiler it links, and the standard
library it resolves `import "std/…"` against. `cx` looks for that library
at ..\lib\cronyx\stdlib relative to its own binary, and Scoop puts a
generated shim on the PATH rather than a link -- a shim is a different
executable and reports itself, so that search would start in the shims
directory and find nothing. Hence CRONYX_STDLIB, the override cx checks
`cronyxc` is the bare compiler driver and is deliberately not on the PATH,
which is the choice the Homebrew formula makes with it too.
version, url, hash and extract_dir are maintained by
